title: felicia minima
intro: Felicia minima, commonly known as Small Felicia or Blue Felicia, is a small, annual herb in the daisy family native to South Africa. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as reduced inflammation, improved digestion, and relief from respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Felicia minima include its antispasmodic, anti-inflammatory, and expectorant properties, which help to calm muscle spasms, reduce swelling, and ease coughs. The bioactive constituents of Felicia minima include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal effects and make it a valuable herbal remedy.
